Subject: Aurelia Systems: integration runway, IP gating, and service-account patterns

Hey Jared / Priya—thanks again for the demo earlier. This thread is to lock down the integration runway and the specific access-controls items we should land during onboarding (SSO/SAML, SCIM attributes, IP allowlist, and service account patterns). I attached a short mutual action plan and templates to make the first implementation sprint predictable.

High-level asks from Redwood: 
- Confirm SSO SAML IdP metadata or provide ACS/EntityID endpoints.
- Share the CIDR blocks for the egress IPs that need allowlisting.
- Confirm SCIM attribute mapping for manager/title and whether you want group sync.
- Approve the proposed ephemeral service-account model in the attached doc.

Suggested cadence: two-week implementation sprint with a dry-run cutover on week 2. Proposed kickoff call: Thursday 10/1 at 10:00am PT (30m). Can you confirm availability?

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, network-allowlist-template.csv, service-account-patterns.md

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1-415-555-0199

From: Jared Mills <jared.mills@aurelia-sys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurelia-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia Systems: integration runway, IP gating, and service-account patterns

Ben—thanks. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions: 

1) SAML: we host IdP in Okta. I can export metadata tonight; ACS URL and Entity ID are standard (I will attach). We do have a signed-response requirement.
2) IP allowlist: our infra team can open a ticket to whitelist outbound egress ranges. Current egress NATs are: 54.210.12.0/24 and 3.129.45.0/24. 
3) SCIM: we currently sync username, email, firstName, lastName, and title. We do want group sync for product access groups. Our SCIM implements PATCH and bulk GET. 
4) Service accounts: we prefer long-lived machine accounts scoped to a single project for audit clarity; ephemeral tokens are fine if they map to the same identity. Can you call out how Redwood will surface the service-account identity in audit logs?

We can do the kickoff Thursday 10/1 10am PT. Priya will join for networking details. Please include Rishi for compliance mapping.

Thanks—Jared
Jared Mills
Head of Platform Security, Aurelia Systems
jared.mills@aurelia-sys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Aurelia Systems: integration runway, IP gating, and service-account patterns

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 5:18 PM Jared Mills <jared.mills@aurelia-sys.com> wrote:
> 1) SAML: we host IdP in Okta. I can export metadata tonight; ACS URL and Entity ID are standard (I will attach). We do have a signed-response requirement.

Thanks Jared — that works. A few implementation notes from the SRE/SE side: 

- SAML: Redwood supports signed responses; during the setup we'll exchange certificates. For the first rollout we recommend SP-initiated flow to minimize user impact. We'll provide an SP metadata blob that you can upload to Okta.
- SCIM: group sync is supported. Our default mapping is: Aurelia 'groups' -> Redwood 'teams' (we'll add a mapping table to the Drive folder). For title/manager, SCIM PATCH is fine. Please confirm internal group names you want to map for initial rollout (e.g., engineering, data-analytics, ops).
- IP allowlist: we'll need the exact egress CIDRs and a contact for traceroute/verify during dry-run. Our egress endpoints are in us-west-2; if you have a VPN appliance we can also whitelist the API gateway FQDN.
- Service accounts: audit footprint: every service account action is logged to the customer's audit stream (timestamp, serviceAccountId, action, token_id_hash). For Dedicated/Private deployments we can also provide raw audit exports to your SIEM. Ephemeral tokens will show the serviceAccountId in logs; we can add token lifecycle events if you want TTL visibility.

I'll add the SCIM mapping draft and a sample Okta import bundle to the Drive link Ben shared.

Next action for us: Ben to send calendar invite for kickoff + provide the Drive folder with docs and the mutual action plan (we'll version during the sprint).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Red wood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
